acid-catalyst-cartridge.label: OC 游戏耗材
acid-catalyst-cartridge.summary: 化合物；GT 流体的含水量与纯度未编码。乙酸乙酯酯化催化额度；与硫酸反应物包分别计量，不能互换。详见模块化工厂页的物料身份教程。
acid-catalyst-cartridge.summaryEn: Compound; the GT fluid does not encode water content or purity. Esterification catalyst allowance; kept separate from the sulfuric-acid reagent dose. See the plant material-identity lesson.

dryer-cartridge.label: OC 游戏耗材
dryer-cartridge.summary: 铝硅酸盐骨架材料；组成、交换阳离子和含水量可变。有限吸水能力；不等同于已活化 3A 分子筛；用后独立收集。详见模块化工厂页的物料身份教程。
dryer-cartridge.summaryEn: Aluminosilicate framework material with variable composition, cations and hydration. Finite drying allowance; not certified activated 3A molecular sieve; collect spent medium separately. See the plant material-identity lesson.

heater-charge.label: OC 游戏耗材
heater-charge.summary: 多组分固体燃料；不是纯碳，也不是热量物质。游戏供热成本；不作为反应试剂，也不由此推算燃烧热。详见模块化工厂页的物料身份教程。
heater-charge.summaryEn: Multicomponent solid fuel, neither pure carbon nor a substance called heat. Game heating cost, not a reagent or a calibrated combustion enthalpy. See the plant material-identity lesson.
